_comment: THE PLATFORM'S GLOBAL in-app/email/sms templates our OWN services send through — one row per (key, locale), upserted by seed-notification-templates.sh on every install. Placeholders use stdlib string.Template ($name, not {name} — see notification-service's own adapters/renderer/safe.py). category is always 'transactional' here: none of these are marketing, so none need a NOTIFY_CONSENT_PURPOSES mapping.

ar.subject: انخفاض في تقييم أحد الموظفين
ar.body: تراجع متوسط تقييم $name إلى $average من 5 خلال آخر تقييماته. يُنصح بمراجعة أدائه في أقرب وقت.
